descriptions.warning: The player disputes a warning issued after an action considered borderline or against community rules.
descriptions.temporaryBan: The player disputes a temporary suspension applied after problematic or repeated behavior.
descriptions.permanentBan: The player disputes a permanent exclusion applied after an action considered serious by moderation.
descriptions.mute: The player disputes a communication restriction applied after a problematic message, comment, or voice/text behavior.

warning.one: One of the player's actions was reported or detected as potentially against the rules.
warning.two: Moderation considered that the behavior required a formal reminder.
warning.three: The appeal makes it possible to check whether the warning was proportionate to the context.

temporaryBan.one: An action or repeated actions were considered problematic enough to temporarily block the account.
temporaryBan.two: The sanction aims to protect the experience of other players while the case is reviewed.
temporaryBan.three: The appeal makes it possible to reassess the duration, justification, and context of the suspension.

permanentBan.one: A serious action or accumulation of incidents was associated with the player's account.
permanentBan.two: Moderation considered that keeping the account active represented a risk to the community.
permanentBan.three: The appeal makes it possible to review the case elements before confirming or canceling the exclusion.

mute.one: A message, comment, or communication behavior was considered inappropriate.
mute.two: The restriction aims to limit problematic interactions without fully blocking the account.
mute.three: The appeal makes it possible to check whether the speech restriction is justified and proportionate.
